compartment.title: Implemented Phase A – image pipeline fixes

compartments.compartment: Implemented the image‑pipeline fixes described in Phase A: injected collected `searchImageUrls` into the lesson generation prompt as visible markdown, added a post‑processor (`injectImagesIntoLesson`) that inserts up to four images under section headings when the AI provides none, and deduplicated the Visual References gallery by using a `Set` keyed on image URL. Updated the generate route, added the new helper file, wrote unit tests, ran the full test suite and pushed the changes as `origin/main`.

compartment.title: Reviewed current lessons and shifted to Phase B

compartments.compartment: Found that all existing lessons contain zero images—both inline markdown and source image counts are empty. Confirmed the search tool was configured for images but no URLs reached the AI. Decided to postpone image‑related testing and move to Phase B for readability improvements. U: I don't think I've created a tavily account, and searxng isn't installed yet. So that's probably why.. Let's continue with phase B instead, and I'll verify images another day

Added a “Key Takeaways” card that extracts the final summary/ conclusion section from lesson markdown and renders it in an amber‑tinted card. Inserted a thin horizontal rule between callout label and body for visual separation. Updated the lesson page to slice out the extracted summary and display it separately. Added comprehensive unit tests covering various heading patterns. All tests pass.
Verified the working tree was clean and that the Phase B changes had already been committed and pushed to `origin/main`.
Recorded the user’s preference to avoid confetti animations in lessons. U: About the fun-ness of the lessons, i'm not a big fan of confetti

compartment.title: Phase C – fun yet grounded enhancements

compartments.compartment: Implemented four “fun” features without flashy effects: a sticky Section Navigator that appears when a lesson has three or more `##` sections, an Image Quality Gate (`LessonImage` component) that shows a skeleton placeholder and a graceful fallback for broken images, inline image captions with source domain attribution, and a Key Terms card that extracts bolded terms from the lesson and displays them as badge‑style chips after the Sources section. Updated the lesson page to wire all components together, ran lint, type‑check and the full test suite, and pushed the changes as `origin/main`.

Captured three representative screenshots (landing page hero, explore page, onboarding chat) using Playwright, optimized their file sizes, added them to a new `screenshots/` directory, and updated the README to display the images with descriptive captions. Committed and pushed the assets. U: Could you take a few screenshots of the site for the readme. Do 3 that represents the application best and add them to the readme

compartment.title: Added flexible lesson categories with user override

compartments.compartment: Extended the `curricula` table with nullable `category` and `subcategory` text columns. Modified the AI curriculum‑plan schema to include `category` and `subcategory`, allowing the model to suggest values during generation. Implemented server‑side discovery of distinct categories for the Explore page, added UI chips for filtering, and exposed a new `listCategories` tRPC procedure. Provided an edit UI on the curriculum detail page so owners can manually override the AI‑assigned category/subcategory. Updated the generate route, API routers, explore pages (web and mobile), and E2E fixture resolver; all tests pass. U: Is it a good idea to add categories for lessons that don't exist yet? Maybe add categories as they're created. I think the ai can classify, but maybe let the user override this plan looks good U: I think the ai can classify, but maybe let the user override
User sent repeat “continue” commands; no additional code changes were required.

facts.ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS: * Visual References gallery deduplicates images by URL using a Set. * Lesson page shows a Section Navigator when a lesson contains three or more top‑level sections. * Image rendering uses a LessonImage component that displays a placeholder while loading and a graceful fallback on error.
